note: Which club pages this project may read, and where the terms reading for each host is recorded. No club's bytes are redistributed here. A real host is added only after its terms of use and robots.txt have been read and the reading written into docs/club_news_sources.md, which is why terms_record is required rather than optional. A club may appear on more than one line -- team news and an injury table are often separate pages -- because a claim cites a document by digest and byte span rather than citing a club. One url may appear only once: the same page registered twice is read twice and coded twice, which would enter one sentence in the evidence table as two claims. The Example FC line stays: it is served offline by the fixture, no request is ever made for it, and it is what exercises the reader when no real host is reachable.
